name: bst-table
description: Bst-Table POC — headless TanStack v9 engine (@bloomskill/table-engine) with swappable MUI and shadcn/Radix style adapters. Proves portability + two-adapter styling.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bloomskill/table-engine && npm run build -w @bloomskill/table-mui && npm run build -w @bloomskill/table-shadcn && npm run build -w @bloomskill/table-mcp
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/shadcn/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run dev -w @bloomskill/demo
scripts.mcp: npm run build -w @bloomskill/table-mcp && vitest run packages/mcp && npm run smoke -w @bloomskill/table-mcp && npm run typecheck:scaffold -w @bloomskill/table-mcp && npm run verify:mcp
scripts.version:patch: node scripts/bump-version.mjs patch && npm install && npm run docs:build
scripts.version:minor: node scripts/bump-version.mjs minor && npm install && npm run docs:build
scripts.version:major: node scripts/bump-version.mjs major && npm install && npm run docs:build
scripts.docs:sync: npm run docs:gen && npm run docs:check
scripts.docs:build: npm run build -w @bloomskill/table-engine && npm run build -w @bloomskill/table-mcp && npm run docs:api && npm run docs:sync
scripts.docs:verify: npm run docs:sync && git diff --exit-code -- apps/docs/docs apps/docs/scripts || (echo '\n✗ docs are stale — a feature changed without regenerating. Run: npm run docs:build  then commit apps/docs.' && exit 1)
scripts.release:preflight: npm whoami || (echo 'npm publish will fail: not authenticated (npm token missing/expired). Run: npm login  (or put a valid //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken in ~/.npmrc), then re-run: npm run release' && exit 1)
scripts.release: npm run release:preflight && npm run build && npm publish -w @bloomskill/table-engine && npm publish -w @bloomskill/table-mui && npm publish -w @bloomskill/table-shadcn && npm publish -w @bloomskill/table-mcp
